query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 80,
  radar_freshness = 30,
  radar_warmth = 85,
  radar_sweetness = 25,
  radar_spiciness = 90,
  radar_earthiness = 50
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%épic%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%spic%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%poivre%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%cannelle%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%clou%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%pepper%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
